label: has coach
definition: Team or sporting organization X has or had person Y as an explicitly identified coach.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit head coach, coach, or assistant coach office; historical coaching office. Excludes: ordinary player or manager alone without a coach title; an opponent or commentator; proposed appointment alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear title or team attachment; a coach-elect or proposed appointment without established tenure. Inverse of coach_of. This does not assert that Y is the sole or current coach.
